known_limits: Force-delete restricted session is enforced at the controller enqueue barrier (EnqueueControlOutbox) and at the agenthub session inbound/outbox gate; the visual UI surfaces and P15 owner APIs are P15 scope. A delivery-refused outbox row (cleanup-only, RESTORE_RECONCILIATION, per-node quarantine) is requeued with a bounded retry_after_unix backoff (30s, repair-2 L-B) so the pump never hot-spins a persistently-refused row; the enqueue guard now refuses probe_outcome/restore_result for a cleanup-only node and QueueProbeOutcome refuses the whole delivery transaction for a tombstoned node (the probe sweeper may re-attempt it at the sweep cadence — fail-closed, not a hot loop).

Restore is a whole-database staging + atomic switch with RESTORE_RECONCILIATION quarantine and no auto-dispatch. The restore/reconcile machinery is code-complete and crash-safe (repair-2 M-B): the operator flow that advances RESTORE_RECONCILIATION->AUTHORIZED and reauthorizes each per-node quarantine is wired by the P15 OPERATOR API — lifecycle.FinalizeRestore / lifecycle.ReauthorizeNode are library surfaces with no production caller in the shipped P14 artifacts. Until the P15 API ships, advancing the restore operation and clearing per-node quarantine requires direct controller-DB/store access or a P15-provided surface; the system fails closed (restore gate stays RESTORE_RECONCILIATION, no wrong-state dispatch) and the outbox pump re-checks the gate at delivery time. The Agent-relative high-water merge (Agent hello tombstones/outbox high-water) is the P19/integration reconciliation step documented in docs/recovery.md, not a silent automatic merge.

Restore/backup file reads are bounded (repair-2 L-A): store.hashAndMode stats every manifest-declared file and refuses anything over the shared store.MaxBackupFileBytes (256 MiB) BEFORE reading, so OpenBackup / ValidateRestore / backup-creation fail closed on an oversized sibling file instead of slurping it; restore.prepareRestoreStage uses the same constant for the in-memory controller.db read.

Non-vacuous: backoff=0 revert makes the pump no-spin test fail (hot spin).
finding_to_fix.L-A: R2f3 - store.hashAndMode os.ReadFile-ed every manifest-declared sibling file with no size cap (the 256 MiB bound at restore.prepareRestoreStage covered only controller.db). FIX: stat BEFORE reading and refuse anything over the shared exported store.MaxBackupFileBytes (256 MiB); restore aliases the same constant. OpenBackup / ValidateRestore / backup-creation all fail closed on an oversized sibling. Test: oversized manifest-declared sibling (sparse truncate, true hash+mode so size is the only refusal reason) refused by both OpenBackup and ValidateRestore.
